wasm_file.description: Path to the WebAssembly file (.wasm) or shared object (.so) to execute.

mode.description: Execution mode: 'command' for standalone WASI apps, 'reactor' for calling exported functions.

reactor_function.description: Name of the exported function to invoke when in reactor mode.

args.description: Command line arguments for the WASM program. In reactor mode, first is function name, rest are params.

directories.description: Directory bindings for WASI virtual filesystem. Format: guest_path:host_path or host_path.

env_vars.description: Environment variables to set in the runtime. Format: NAME=VALUE.

force_interpreter.description: Forcibly run WASM in interpreter mode rather than JIT.

forbidden_plugins.description: List of plugin names to ignore/disable.

enable_time_measuring.description: Enable generating code for counting execution time.

enable_gas_measuring.description: Enable generating code for counting gas burned.

enable_instruction_count.description: Enable generating code for counting WebAssembly instructions executed.

enable_all_statistics.description: Enable all statistics options (time, gas, instruction counting).

time_limit.description: Limitation of maximum execution time in milliseconds. 0 for no limit.

gas_limit.description: Limitation of execution gas. 0 for no limit.

memory_page_limit.description: Limitation of pages (64 KiB each) in every memory instance. 0 for no limit.

disable_import_export_mut_globals.description: Disable Import/Export of mutable globals proposal.

enable_all.description: Enable all WebAssembly proposals and features.
